reason: Adds an opencode and oh-my-openagent-compatible agent preset for DeepSeek Harness, centered on multi-role orchestration, delegated workflows, configurable model routing, and integrated shell, filesystem, search, and project-context tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供兼容 opencode 与 oh-my-openagent 的多角色智能体预设，支持任务编排、模型路由、文件与终端操作、搜索及项目上下文注入。
summaries.en: Provides a DeepSeek Harness preset compatible with opencode and oh-my-openagent, supporting multi-role orchestration, model routing, filesystem and terminal tools, search, and project-context injection.

capabilities: Runs shell commands through a persistent PTY
Reads, writes, edits, and patches local files
Delegates work to multiple subagents and workflows
Performs web search and HTTP fetching
Injects project rules and context files into prompts
Uses configurable primary and fallback models
